info.bio:
Hay varios artistas con este nombre.

1. Rain (Hangul:비), es un cantante, bailarín, actor y modelo procedente de Corea del Sur, y es uno de los artistas más famosos y exitosos alrededor de toda Asia. Además ha trabajado exitosas series coreanas en su carrera como actor, como es Full House, hasta ahora su más famosa actuación junto con la actriz y modelo Song Hye Kyo. Es uno de los iconos juveniles de Corea y es muy aclamado en continente asiático ya sea en Japón, China, Malasia, entre otros.

scenes.name: Space-rock y psicodelia extrema de los noventa
scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
scenes.desc: Fundiendo los estilos psicodélicos que preferían la jam libre (acid-rock, space-rock, raga-rock), muchos grupos esculpen empresas sonoras épicas: Fuzzhead, Crawlspace, Pressurehed, Farflung, Fuxa, Gravitar (el Metal Machine Music de Lou Reed con ritmo), Pelt, Primordial Undermind, Escapade y, por encima de todos, Bardo Pond (Bufo Alvarius, Amanita) y Hash Jar Tempo. Texas recupera la supremacía de la locura psicodélica (Ed Hall, Cherubs, ST 37, Mike Gunn, Charalambides, Linus Pauling Quartet, la Vas Deferens Organization de Dallas); San Francisco, la psicodelia ruidosa de Mason Jones (Trance, Subarachnoid Space). En Nueva Zelanda, Roy Montgomery (Dadamah, Dissolve), Dean Roberts, Flies Inside The Sun; en Japón, Kousokuya, Mainliner, Musica Transonic, Acid Mothers Temple, Ghost.

podcast.title: Precursor to Oasis (1991)
podcast.body: Rain was the band Liam Gallagher was in prior to the formation of Oasis. After a Rain gig in 1991, Liam and his bandmates invited Noel Gallagher to become their manager, but Noel instead joined as lead guitarist, leading to the band's metamorphosis into Oasis. "Liam started a van called Rain. After a rain gig in 1991, Liam and his mates asked Noel to be their manager."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Co-founding and Early Gigs
podcast.body: Rain was co-founded on April 16, 1990, by guitarist Paul "Bonehead" Arthurs and singer Chris Hutton. The group began playing gigs at the Boardwalk in Manchester in late 1990. "The following year, April 16, 1990 to be exact, a group called Rain was co-founded by guitarist Paul Bohnhead Arthors and a singer named Chris Hutton."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Noel and Liam Gallagher's Integration
podcast.body: By mid-1990, Noel Gallagher had joined Rain and taken over leadership. His younger brother, Liam Gallagher, also became the singer of the group. "By mid-year, Noel had joined up and taken over and his little brother had become the singer of Rain."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Predecessor to Oasis
podcast.body: Rain was the original name of the band before Noel Gallagher took control and renamed them Oasis. Liam Gallagher was the singer for Rain. "his little brother Liam had become the singer in a band called Rain."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: We Are The Road Crew - A History of Roadies

podcast.title: Renamed Oasis
podcast.body: After Noel Gallagher took full creative control and insisted on being the sole songwriter, the band formerly known as Rain accepted his terms and was subsequently renamed Oasis. "Now, the rain took it and were renamed Oasis."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
